tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Proper Continuous Maps Are Closed] ↗ \cite{LeeTM} \dcref{chA:A.5} Suppose $M$ is a topological space, $N$ is a locally compact Hausdorff space, and $F : M \to N$ is continuous and proper. Then $F$ is a closed map.
